{{Quote|Need I remind you that it is I who leads our people in the Senate!|Orn Free Taa, to political rival [[Cham Syndulla/Legends|Cham Syndulla]]|audio=NeedIRemindYou-LoR.flac|<ref name="LoR">{{TCW|Liberty on Ryloth}}</ref>}}
'''Orn Free Taa''' was a corpulent [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rutian/Legends|Rutian]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who served as the [[Senator/Legends|senator]] of [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. As the leader of the [[Rim Faction/Legends|Rim Faction]], he was among the most senior members of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]. Indeed, Taa's power within the Senate helped skyrocket both [[Mas Amedda/Legends|Mas Amedda]] and [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] to power. He also had a relationship with [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]].

==Biography==
===Under Valorum===
{{Quote|Do you know why Valorum loves to attend the opera? Because it's the only place on Coruscant where an entire audience will applaud him.|Orn Free Taa in 32 BBY|<ref name="COD" />}}
Born on the poor [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]], the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] Orn Free worked as a tax collector before becoming a [[Senator/Legends|senator]] in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], representing his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]].<ref name="Databank" /> Taa used his position to indulge his whims to excess, growing obese and developing a notorious reputation for corruption,<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|208|Taa, Orn Free}}</ref> while his own people toiled in squalor.<ref name="Encyclopedia">{{SWE|characters|ornfreetaa|Orn Free Taa}}</ref> He readily paraded his two beautiful [[Orn Free Taa's Twi'lek aide|aides]], [[Pampy/Legends|Pampy]] and [[Supi/Legends|Supi]], around as badges of prestige.<ref name="Databank" /> Following the [[Supreme Chancellor election, 40 BBY|election]] of [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum's]] as [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] in [[40 BBY/Legends|40 BBY]],<ref name="The New Essential Chronology">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Taa became one of his most vocal opponents in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]], as Ryloth had been repeatedly denied favored world status.<ref name="COD" />

Taa owned a private balcony in the [[Coruscant Opera/Legends|Coruscant opera]], where his large frame filled the space of three seats and required a specifically modified chair.<ref name="COD" /> In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="Essential Readers">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> he attended a [[Unidentified Bith opera company|performance]] of ''[[The Brief Reign of Future Wraiths]]'', accompanied in the balcony by A [[Lethan/Legends|Lethan]] Twi'lek consort, along with a dozen guests including Senators [[Toonbuck Toora/Legends|Toonbuck Toora]], [[Passel Argente/Legends|Passel Argente]], [[Edcel Bar Gane/Legends|Edcel Bar Gane]], and [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], along with two of Palpatine's aides, [[Kinman Doriana/Legends|Kinman Doriana]] and [[Sate Pestage/Legends|Sate Pestage]]. When Valorum arrived late to the [[Opera/Legends|opera]] and received a momentous applause, he bowed to the members of Taa's because, who returned the gesture. Taa commented in [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]] that the unpopular Valorum was only in attendance because no other audience would applaud him, prompting Toora and Argente to criticize the Chancellor's flaws openly. Taa questioned the purpose of Valorum's bow, which Toora believed was an early attempt to rally the support of the senators in the balcony to support Valorum's forthcoming [[Senate Resolution BR-0371|taxation]] of [[Free Trade Zone/Legends|Free Trade Zones]]. After Taa considered other more notable senators, such as [[Bail Antilles/Legends|Bail Antilles]] and [[Horox Ryyder/Legends|Horox Ryyder]], and [[Tendau Bendon/Legends|Tendau Bendon]], both senators quickly realized that Palpatine was the true intended recipient, as he had been convincing Valorum of the tax plan's necessity.<ref name="COD" />

The senator's discussed Valorum's proposal, with Taa believing that the result would be determined by partisan contests between [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] regions, with the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Wolds]] in favor and the near [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] opposed. When Toora asked Palpatine to reveal details of his conversation with Valorum, she asked Taa to switch on the balcony's noise cancellation feature, though Palpatine did not speak until Pestage examined the device's security. The senator from [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] justified the tax plan as necessary to limit the influence of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], which Taa interpreted as a view that the Federation's link with the Outer Rim Territories could not be alienated due to its benefits in trade between the Republic. Palpatine rejected Taa's interpretation, responding that the Trade Federation could eclipse influence in the Senate if not stopped. As Palpatine elaborated on his stance on the taxation plan further, Taa commented that he sounded like a future party whip, shortly before the operatic performance began.<ref name="COD" />

Taa was the leader of the [[Rim Faction/Legends|Rim Faction]] of senators; as such, he advocated lessening the Republic's interference in local affairs. Taa was the senator who nominated both [[Mas Amedda/Legends|Mas Amedda]] for the position of [[Vice Chair/Legends|Vice Chair]] and Palpatine for the position of Chancellor; both of which became successful in their positions.

===Under Palpatine===
Taa was a member of the [[Allocations Committee|Allocations]] and [[Financial Appropriations Committee|Appropriations Committees]] and was one of the first members of the [[Loyalist Committee/Legends|Loyalist Committee]]. A [[Militarists/Legends|Militarist]] in the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]], he was one of the biggest supporters of the [[Military Creation Act/Legends|Military Creation Act]], which was counter to the Twi'lek's cultural disdain of violence. However, he approved of an attempt by Palpatine to negotiate with [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] just prior to the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

When Senators [[Tikkes/Legends|Tikkes]], [[Bufus Ritsomas]], [[Danry Ledwellow/Legends|Danry Ledwellow]], and [[Wuja Wojaine]] were caught and arrested for their involvement in a [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]] ring from their sectors, Taa expressed his disgust in public. All convicted Senators were put under house arrest to await trial,<ref name="HNN50">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|50|news/1344_5.html|Senators Implicated in Slave Ring}}</ref> but one week later, Tikkes escaped on his [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] vessel, the ''[[Krakana Current]]''. Furious and unsure whether to denounce this escape as part of a conspiracy or a result of incompetence on security's part, Taa denounced it as proof of Tikkes' guilt. Senator [[Edcel Bar Gane/Legends|Edcel Bar Gane]] of [[Roona/Legends|Roona]], on the other hand, thought that Taa was jumping to conclusions and viewed Tikkes' situation as a flight for his life after Senator [[Aks Moe/Legends|Aks Moe's]] death.<ref name="HNN51">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|51|news/13411_7.html|Senator Tikkes Jumps Bail}}</ref> Taa's accusation would prove to be correct when Tikkes joined forces with Count Dooku and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="ATOC">{{Film|II}}</ref> After Neimoidian senator [[Lott Dod/Legends|Lott Dod]] ended up in a skyway accident, Taa, when appearing on the ''[[Amberdawn]]'' morning news broadcast focusing on the accident, joked on the air that Dod was probably planning to file a lawsuit against the [[Skyways Flyer|Skyway Flyer]] company for alleged anti-Neimoidian sentiments, and planned to issue evidence of them interfering with Neimoidian markets. The next day, Taa ended up making a public apology for his remarks on the Amberdawn after Dod complained about the joke being tasteless.<ref name="HNN54">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|54|news/1352_3.html|Senator Taa Apologizes Over Dod "Joke"}}</ref>

===Clone Wars===
====Battle of Ryloth====
{{Quote|The people have my promise that the clone army will leave once Ryloth is free of those droids!|Orn Free Taa|audio=OrnFreeTaaPromise-LoR.flac|<ref name="LoR" />}}
[[File:Triumphant_fighters_on_Ryloth.png|thumb|right|230px|Taa following the [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|Battle of Ryloth]].]]
When the Senator's homeworld of Ryloth [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|became the site of Separatist invasion]], he was rightly worried about the welfare of his people. With the blockade in orbit and the onslaught on the surface, it seemed that the resistance would fail. The Jedi Council dispatched Senator [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]] to negotiate humanitarian aid from [[King/Legends|King]] [[Katuunko/Legends|Katuunko]] of [[Toydaria/Legends|Toydaria]], in order to deliver supplies to Ryloth. Taa made a personal plea to the [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarians]] via hologram regarding how his people are suffering. However, the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] representative [[Lott Dod/Legends|Lott Dod]] made a counterargument that supporting Ryloth would end Toydaria's neutrality. Officially, Katuunko refused to get involved in the war, he nonetheless assisted in delivering the supplies to Ryloth, right under Dod's nose.<ref name="SL">{{TCW|Supply Lines}}</ref>

After operations led by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] were successful in breaching the Separatist blockade and beginning a ground assault, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] briefed Taa and the Senate about what progress the clone army had made so far; namely, the securing of many villages and the entire southern hemisphere of Ryloth.<ref name="LoR" />

Windu believed that the Separatist occupation could only be defeated by capturing the capital city of [[Lessu City/Legends|Lessu]], and that this could only be achieved with the help of Taa's political rival [[Cham Syndulla/Legends|Cham Syndulla]]. Though both Taa and Syndulla were dubious over the possibility of an alliance between them, Windu managed to secure both of their aid through their mutual wish to save their people. Taa promised that once the battle was over and there were no more Separatist droids on this planet, the clone army would leave the system immediately, while Syndulla vowed not to make an attempt to seize power from Taa.<ref name="LoR" />

After Master Windu successfully captured the capital, as well as Separatist leader [[Wat Tambor/Legends|Wat Tambor]], Senator Taa attended a parade that marked the victory and liberation of Ryloth.<ref name="LoR" />

====Part of the Council of Neutral Systems====
Sometime during the Clone Wars, Senator Taa was asked by [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]] of [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] to consider joining her [[Council of Neutral Systems/Legends|Council of Neutral Systems]].<ref name="TCW New Battlefronts">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: New Battlefronts: The Visual Guide]]''</ref> He accompanied the Duchess during her voyage to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to plea her case to the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]. He was present during the [[Skirmish aboard the Coronet/Legends|incident]] aboard the [[Coronet/Legends|''Coronet'']], during which he bore witness to the horrid monstrosities deployed by the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] in an attempt to murder the Duchess.<ref name="VoT">{{TCW|Voyage of Temptation}}</ref>

====Senate hostage crisis====
{{Quote|Look at Senator Orn Free Taa! He looks ''so'' unhappy!|Ziro the Hutt, to Orn Free Taa|audio=OrnFreeTaaUnhappy.flac|<ref name="HC">{{TCW|Hostage Crisis}}</ref>}}
[[File:Orn_Free_Taa_Palpatine.png|thumb|left|230px|Free Taa with Chancellor Palpatine during the hostage crisis]]
When the notorious bounty hunter [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] and his posse were able to successfully enter the Senate Building and capture a group of important Senators, it was Senator Orn Free Taa who alerted Chancellor Palpatine to the emergency. Taa remained with the Chancellor throughout the duration of the crisis and was privy to the Chancellor's refusal to bow to the bounty hunter's demand: the pardon of crime lord [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]].<ref name="HC" />

However, when it became clear that Bane was in control of the Senate, Palpatine agreed to pardon the Hutt. Orn Free Taa was placed in charge of a pardon chip, which under his authority, would ensure the release of Ziro. After freeing Ziro, Taa organized a force of clone troopers to ensure the Chancellor's safety, as well as to prevent the escape of Bane. Unfortunately, Bane had rigged the room holding the hostage Senators with detonation devices, and as such, the Republic were forced to allow him his freedom.<ref name="HC" />

Fortunately, when Bane detonated the devices despite the compliance of the Chancellor, Jedi Knight Anakin Skywalker foresaw Bane's treachery and was able to save the lives of the hostages.<ref name="HC" />

==Personality and traits==
===Tasteless Twi'lek===
{{Quote|Ah! Dessert! Excellent!''"<br/>"''This morsel might prove too much even for the legendary appetite of Orn Free Taa.|Orn Free Taa and Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="VoT" />}}
[[File:OrnFreeTaaAide-SWCTP.png|thumb|right|300px|Orn Free Taa was unsatisfied with companions who were not Lethan Twi'lek females.]]
A Twi'lek of the Rutian variety, he had<ref name="FF106" /> cerulean<ref name="COD">''[[Cloak of Deception]]''</ref> blue skin, pointed teeth like other males of his species, and beady, piercing eyes steel-blue in color. These were all ordinary traits, despite the man being a rare example of Rutian Twi'lek by having four<ref name="FF106" /> misshapen,<ref name="CSWE" /> enormous<ref name="Databank" /> lekku<ref name="FF106" /> that stored his fat,<ref name="Databank" /> instead of the common two.<ref name="FF106" /> The tentacles hung off his head like sated snakes along his large chest. Additionally, Taa's face featured pouty red lips and eyelids, and his double chin was similar in size to a bantha's feed bag.<ref name="COD" /> 

Taa was distinguished by his four lekku and was striking as he was<ref name="FF106" /> corpulent<ref name="Databank" /> and much larger than the average Twi'lek, standing at 1.93 meters.<ref name="FF106" /> Taa's name hailed from Twi'lek culture; "Orn" meant "bird of prey," and "Freetaa" translated to "brave."<ref name="GCG">''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]''</ref> According to Obi-Wan Kenobi, Taa had a legendary appetite.<ref name="VoT" />

Through combining this appearance with his considerable power and influence, Taa became sought after by Twi'lek females. The senator acknowledged he was not the most handsome Twi'lek, however, but learned that the power and wealth he had guaranteed attractiveness rivaled by the most beloved holovid idol.<ref name="FF106" /> Taa favored the rare and exotic and believed showing off expensive tastes, no matter how ugly or tasteless, would portray him as worldly and refined to associates. He liked knowing what his items cost to boast about after. His great admiration of the Lethan Twi'lek subspecies was considered an exception to the tastelessness, however. He was not satisfied any companion who was not a Lethan female and often had one on his arm.<ref name="FF106" /> Taa still paraded around his<ref name="Databank" /> non-Lethan<ref name="Pampy">{{DB|character|pampy|Pampy}}</ref><ref name="Supi">{{DB|character|supi|Supi}}</ref> aides Pampy and Supi as badges of prestige, nonetheless.<ref name="Databank" /> 

===Ryloth's representative===
{{Quote|Few cultures have suffered as much from slavery as the Twi'leks, and to know that that kind of blood money has reached as far as the Senate sickens me. I say throw the leeches out of office, and then let them have a taste of the shackles themselves!|An angry Orn Free Taa on HoloNet News|<ref name="HNN50" />}}
[[File:OrnFreeTaa-E1IG.jpg|thumb|left|350px|Orn Free Taa often made his voice heard in the Senate.]]
On Ryloth, Taa was a corrupt and greedy tax collector who knew that moving onto the Senate would not only increase his power, influence, and wealth, but would also allow him to indulge himself in his whims. His desire for those things and a real concern for Ryloth&mdash;contradictory to his reputation&mdash;eventually got him to Coruscant.<ref name="FF106" /> On Coruscant, he became quite decadent, surrounding himself with Twi'lek consorts, wearing gaudy robes,<ref name="Databank" /> and finding possibilities beyond his wildest dreams.<ref name="VD">''[[Star Wars: The Phantom Menace: The Expanded Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> 

Taa, highly visible and vocal, made sure his voice was heard in the Senate debates, even though he sometimes had nothing to add. The man was remarkably effective as an advocate for Republic systems outside the Core Worlds, and was always willing to help others in need, especially if payback was involved. Even if he was corrupt, the Twi'lek was a firm believer in the Republic, speaking in its defense multiple times.<ref name="FF106" /> He viewed galactic government as just sport for the mighty, which he thought himself to be.<ref name="VD" />

[[File:OrnFreeTaa_TCW.png|thumb|right|350px|Orn Free Taa felt his people did not need to be enslaved.]]
There were instances when<ref name="HNN50" /> the law-abiding<ref name="FF106" /> Taa had spoken his outrage at particular Senators for what he viewed as injustices against the Republic and Ryloth, exemplified when Senator Tikkes and other members' enslaving ring was uncovered.<ref name="HNN50" /> Taa, a strong supporter of law,<ref name="FF106" /> did not support slavery or believe it necessary for the people of his planet, viewing them as suffering more from it than most peoples.<ref name="HNN50" /> Unfortunately, for all his crying out about corruption, the man often damaged causes instead of helping them due to his well-documented indulgences<ref name="FF106" /> that were symbolic of what the Separatists thought was rotten about the Republic.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

Taa was disliked on his homeworld as some thought he had grown far too comfortable living a pampered life on Coruscant, losing touch with the day-to-day realities of Ryloth's people.<ref name="Twi'lek">{{SWE|groups|twileks|Twi'leks}}</ref> Cham Syndulla viewed him as uncaring for the Twi'lek's fate and corrupt,<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> which he was.<ref name="FF106" /> 

==Skills and abilities==
Taa was able to ruin others' political careers and maintained dirt on politicians, ensuring that he would never be removed from office. The Twi'lek had even driven his enemies to political suicide. Taa was a diplomat who learned the art of the activity from the recognized masters of it. He had knowledge on bureaucracy, galactic politics, and Ryloth, and had skill in appraisal, bluffing, computer use and gathering information. Taa could read, write, and speak Twi'leki,<ref name="Gamer10">{{GamerCite|10|Galactic Power Brokers}}</ref> the language of his species,<ref name="FaD">[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Force and Destiny'' Core Rulebook]]</ref> and could also speak Basic and Huttese, and use his lekku for communication.<ref name="Gamer10" /> The Twi'lek was proficient in the usage of simple weapons.<ref name="Gamer10" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Qui-GonJabba.jpg|thumb|left|230px|Qui-Gon Jinn meets with Jabba while Orn Free Taa watches in ''The Phantom Menace'' video game.]]
Orn Free Taa is featured in all three episodes of the [[prequel trilogy]]. He was played by [[Jerome Blake]] in [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']]. He is played by [[Matthew Rowan]] in [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']] and [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']]. In ''Revenge of the Sith'', he has one line of dialogue, which was dubbed by [[Matthew Wood]]. He utters "Watch it." to [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] when the [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] seems to either be in his way, or bumps into him at the [[Republic Executive Building/Legends|Republic Executive Building]]. Wood also provided the voice of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] in the film, and also several [[Star Wars Legends|Expanded Universe]] productions. Stock Footage of Rowan as Taa is seen in a full-motion cutscene of the video game ''[[Star Wars Battlefront: Elite Squadron]]''. In ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'', he is played by voice-actor [[Phil LaMarr]] using a French accent. He is portrayed by [[David W. Collins]] in the HoloNet News — A Galaxy Divided segment.

Orn Free Taa's appearance in [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (video game)|''The Phantom Menace'' video game]] is only a brief cameo. When the player, controlling [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], falls into [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure's]] [[Jabba's private box|beast pit]], Orn Free Taa is seen standing next to Jabba.
